collisions.interpretation: Reported aliases and pose/calibration examples are retained. Every exact and D4 group is contained by leakage_group_id.

deprioritized_areas.reason: L4 already has ten crossing representations, all exact- and D4-distinct.
Conventional, curved, adiabatic, and periodic coupling mechanisms already occupy substantial L4 capacity; the missing value is in curriculum bridges and higher-order systems.
Single-loop, structured-loop, and cavity families are populated; new work should change the resonant graph rather than ring dimensions.
Pitch, count, or width changes without a new repetition law are realizations, not new representation grammars.

non_exact_review_pressure.interpretation: These deterministic signals prioritize curator review. Neither silhouette similarity nor coarse AST reuse proves semantic duplication.
